section_5_1_input_contract: One structured claim record at a time (from the run's structured_agent_outputs.json records list), fields run_id/ticker/agent/timestamp/claim/evidence/entities/factors/direction/confidence/source_type/source_refs plus claim_id/source_agent_output_id/claim_quality; identical core fields produced by both the Legacy adapter and the v4.2 Shadow/Primary path.
alpha_taxonomy_source: comqutor_alpha/alpha_library/alpha_taxonomy_v1.yaml (matches the frozen plan's own named path exactly)
factor_alpha_distinction: Distinct concepts, never conflated: factors are per-claim semantic descriptors from §5.1; alphas are the canonical MVP-10 taxonomy hypotheses. Bridged explicitly via FACTOR_ALPHA_WEIGHTS plus keyword matching in alpha_mapper.py.
existing_alpha_mapper_status_note: Tier 1 (deterministic keyword/factor) and Tier 3 (deterministic fallback) are PRODUCTION_ACTIVE and fully wired into the real pipeline and persistence (file + DB). Tier 2 (LLM classification) is code-complete and already live-wired to the shared Week2LLMGateway, but its production authority is explicitly PRODUCT_VALIDATION_MISSING per semantic_authority_matrix.csv, gated on the same missing John-20 set as PD-005.
john_label_format: UNKNOWN — PD-005 requires John to supply claims + labels + rubric + version + sign-off owner; none of this exists in the repository. Two unrelated fixtures exist in tests/ (a 20-case engineering stand-in with no provenance header, and an unrelated 30-case real-report robustness set) and must not be treated as John's set.
evaluation_target: >=80% accuracy on John's 20 labeled claims (Development Plan §5.2, §10 Week 2 gate, and Definition of Done all state this target)
multi_alpha_mapping_note: The frozen plan itself is internally inconsistent: §5.2's worked example uses a plural JSON key (matched_alphas: [...]) while §10's acceptance-gate prose says singular 'matched_alpha'. Current code and the alpha_matches DB table (UNIQUE(run_id, claim_id)) have already committed to a single authoritative matched_alpha per claim plus auxiliary candidate lists, without documented product sign-off on that resolution.
score_range: [0.0, 1.0], clamped and rounded to 4dp (structure_schema.clamp_score) -- not literally stated as a bound in the frozen text but consistent with every example given
threshold: 0.35 confirmed by frozen plan and matched by DEFAULT_MIN_MATCH_SCORE in code, EXCEPT A101/A102/A103 bypass it entirely via an independent AI-alpha hard gate
top_k: 3 confirmed by frozen plan ('top-3 alphas') and matched by code ([:3] slicing in three places)
mapper_llm_input: claim, evidence, factors, direction, allowed_alpha_ids, and up to 3 deterministic eligible candidates (with taxonomy core_thesis/trigger_signals/confirmation_signals) -- confidence is NOT included
deterministic_candidate_generation: SPECIFIED and IMPLEMENTED: keyword index (alpha_id/names/core_thesis/keywords/trigger_signals/confirmation_signals) plus an explicit factor-to-alpha weight table (FACTOR_ALPHA_WEIGHTS). No embeddings, vector search, or candidate IDs.
deterministic_fallback: SPECIFIED (frozen plan item 3, glossed precisely by semantic_authority_matrix.csv) and IMPLEMENTED: not a distinct algorithm -- retains the already-computed Tier 1 result unchanged, with an explicit degradation-reason status recorded.
no_match_behavior: NOT_FOUND in frozen plan (silent on this case). CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION: record retained with match_status='no_match', matched_alpha=None, score=0.0 -- never dropped, no special NONE alpha, no dedicated review queue. Never product-specified.
direction_role: Used as a genuine scoring input (8% weight) and an opposing-pair/ambiguity signal; passed through unchanged to output; never reinterpreted into later Evidence Stance vocabulary (supports_alpha/opposes_alpha/etc.), which is explicitly out of scope for §5.2.
claim_confidence_role: UNUSED -- record.get('confidence') is never read anywhere in alpha_mapper.py despite being present in the frozen plan's own worked input example. PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED.
section_5_2_output_contract: alpha_matches.json: {schema_version, mapper_version, minimum_match_score, run_id, ticker, matches: [...]}. Each match record: run_id/ticker/agent/claim_id/source_agent_output_id/claim/evidence/factors/direction (REQUIRED_CONFIRMED); matched_alpha (singular, nullable)/matched_alpha_name/score/keyword_score/factor_score/direction_score/match_status (REQUIRED_CONFIRMED); candidate_scores/top_candidates/eligible_candidates/plausible_alphas/secondary_alphas/ai_alpha_matches (OPTIONAL_CONFIRMED, read by some downstream consumers); matched_evidence_stance and related fields (NOT_REQUIRED, additive, PD-006-gated); claim_quality (REQUIRED_CONFIRMED passthrough). Mirrored in the alpha_matches DB table, one row per (run_id, claim_id).
section_5_3_expected_input: NOTHING from §5.2. §5.3 Structure Extractor is a parallel sibling consumer of §5.1's structured_agent_outputs.json, not a downstream consumer of alpha_matches.json -- confirmed by both the frozen plan's own §3 data-flow list and the current code's self-documented artifact-lineage table in routes_research.py. This corrects a working assumption in this precheck task's own framing.
entity_exposure_construction_stage: §5.7 Exposure Engine (exposure_engine.py), a separate, later pipeline stage (_run_week3_graph_pipeline) writing a separate artifact (entity_alpha_exposures.json). Not §5.2's responsibility beyond carrying `ticker` on every output record, which it already does.
out_of_scope_for_5_2: Evidence Stance stance vocabulary (supports_alpha/opposes_alpha/mentions_alpha/neutral_background/supports_counter_alpha) -- JOHN_LATER_REQUIREMENT, PD-006, NOT_APPROVED, SHADOW_ONLY
B2 conflict evidence-admissibility -- §5.6, conflict_detector.py, further gated by PD-007
Entity Exposure (ticker x alpha) computation -- §5.7, exposure_engine.py
reusable_existing_components: alpha_mapper._apply_optional_classifier + Week2LLMGateway.invoke_json_with_trace (Tier 2, already live-wired via routes_research.py's shared llm_gateway)
alpha_mapper's Tier 3 fallback (retained Tier-1 result + classifier status metadata)
save_alpha_matches / alpha_matches.json / alpha_matches DB table + repository.py persistence
implementation_gaps: John's real 20 labeled claims (data only, not a code gap)
Product sign-off on single-vs-multi-alpha output cardinality
Product sign-off on claim confidence's role (if any) in alpha score
Product sign-off on the elaborated Tier-1 scoring formula and the AI-alpha 0.35-threshold carve-out for A101/A102/A103
Formal production-authority graduation of the already-live Tier-2 LLM classifier
product_decision_required: Supply John's real 20 labeled claims + rubric + version + sign-off owner (PD-005, still open)
Resolve single- vs multi-alpha mapping cardinality per claim (frozen plan is internally inconsistent on this point)
Define the role (if any) of claim confidence in alpha match score
Approve or revise the elaborated Tier-1 scoring formula (0.50/0.30/0.08/0.12) and the AI-alpha hard-gate threshold bypass
Approve Tier-2 LLM classifier for production authority once the above are resolved
spec_code_conflicts: §5.2's worked JSON example uses a plural 'matched_alphas' array key while §10's Week 2 acceptance-gate prose uses singular 'matched_alpha' -- an inconsistency inside the frozen document itself

tests/test_week2_labeled_accuracy.py and tests/golden_cases/labeled_claims_v1.json self-describe as John's 'approved labeled set', directly conflicting with PD-005's explicit BLOCKED_BY_PRODUCT_OWNER / 'do not substitute a locally invented set' status for the same concept
The AI-alpha hard gate (A101/A102/A103) bypasses the frozen 'threshold 0.35' rule entirely, with no located PD/ADR approval
